title: One place for the board's actions: Ship and Review start the same way from the app and the command, with a setting for the review loop
notes:
Today the board's actions live in two places and the command does less than the app (found 2026-11-05):
- Ship starts only from an app gesture: startsShip/landsInShip in src/shared/board/board.ts gate on a drag or right-arrow, board-view.ts calls bridge.shipCard, main's shipFlow (src/main/ship/ship-flow.ts) makes the worktree and starts the agent. `dashboard board move <id> Ship` only writes the card file; nothing starts.
- The review loop starts from main's reviewSweep (src/main/ship/review-flow.ts), which polls in-flight worktrees every 5 s and starts a review when the card's worktree board gains a pull request number, whoever moved it.

The user's decision: the board command is deliberate, not a tidy-up, so it must do what the app does, and the logic lives in one place.
- One main-side "card entered a column" handler owns the actions. The app's gestures and the board command both ask main to move the card (the command over the socket, through app-handshake.ts; it starts the app if needed, as #205's pane/project commands do), and main runs the same move-plus-action. No action code stays in the renderer; board-view.ts only asks.
- Into Ship (any column to Ship): start the ship, exactly as the drag does today, from the app or the command. A plain file edit of a card (an agent editing its own worktree board) is not a move request and starts nothing.
- Into Review: start the review loop on the card's pull request when the user moves it there (app or command). When a shipped card's agent finishes and the card reaches Review on its own, the loop starts only if the new setting allows it.
- New setting, review.autoLoop (settings screen row and settings.json): on (today's behaviour) or off. Off: a card that reaches Review on its own just waits there; the user starts the loop by moving it to Review themselves or with a key / `dashboard board review <id>`. The user's cousin runs with it off.
- The 5 s worktree sweep stays only for noticing the PR number; it no longer decides to loop by itself.
- Tests for the transition table (which column change, from which source, with which setting, starts what). docs/board hard-rules and decisions updated (the old "a move into Ship must come from a gesture" decision is replaced; say why). Help and settings docs updated.
